option_relations.rationale: Acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) of the inferior wall is a subtype of STEMI, which is described in leaf B1.1 and B4.1.
Coronary artery disease progression with graft failure is a broader class containing the conditions described in leaf B1.2 and B1.4.
Acute inferior ST-elevation myocardial infarction (secondary to saphenous vein graft occlusion) is equivalent to the condition described in leaf B1.1.
Acute posterior and inferior myocardial infarction (STEMI equivalent) due to saphenous vein graft occlusion is a subtype of STEMI, which is described in leaf B1.1 and B4.1.
